items.task: Round for core without a change of athenak/src or python/nrpic (about ninety minutes). (1) The queue marker (decision 0037 items 3 and 4; harness/RULES.md section 'Shared card queue'; `harness/bin/nrpic-queue check-dispatch`): the dispatcher's variable NRPIC_QUEUE_DISPATCH is inherited by the jobs that scripts/ submit, so a job could itself register and submit a card run beside the dispatcher. In scripts/ (yours: the sbatch wrappers, gpu_batch.sh, gpu_run.sh, submit_chain.sh and what a chain hands to its next segment) remove the variable from the environment of every job; a chain still resubmits its own next segment (one job of it in the queue: that hand-over is allowed). Test with the chain script's fake-Slurm test and harness/tests/rc_fixture.py; no real job for the test. (2) Provenance (decision 0038 item 3; Track E's request in your inbox): seven ablation runs of Track E's reproduction record an executable of scratch/core/exe/core_noise-level2/ with a hash beginning 468109, and the file there now hashes d7069a4e; the earlier set was kept as scratch/core/exe/core_noise-level2_6ca93cba/. Establish by hashes which file the seven runs used, write the provenance (commit, build, hashes) where E's run check can point to it, answer E; write into your HANDOFF that a published executable is never replaced in place (a new directory name per publication). (3) Release core-v0.7: byte regression of the release builds .work/build_cpu_v07 and .work/build_gpu_v07 against the candidate on processors; the card checks wait in the shared queue (q0039, q0035, q0036): judge them if they have ended, else say pending. If q0039 is judged, send the orchestrator the sentence for the core-v0.7 row of CLAUDE.md (outbox). (4) Ladder row 4: the runs of q0028 and q0029 (level 3 of the bisection: a member and a control) have ended: close them, fates by the rule, update the bracket and the figure; the other entries wait. (5) The next source session (one Fable session of about two hours is affordable before Friday): from tracks/core/interfaces/REQUESTS_WAVE3.md, stage/G2/OPEN.md and the tracks' requests in your inbox, name in order the source items that a gate of a track waits for, each with the test that would show it works and the reference solution that exists; write that list as tracks/core/NEXT_SOURCE.md.
